description: This file implements the CustomerPolicyService interface, providing methods to purchase, cancel, and list customer policies within an insurance management backend system.

classes.name: CustomerPolicyServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CustomerPolicyService for purchasing and managing customer policies.

methods.name: purchasePolicy
methods.description: Creates and saves a new customer policy for a given customer and policy, with specified start/end dates and premium.

methods.name: cancelPolicy
methods.description: Deactivates a customer policy by setting its active status to false.

methods.name: listForCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves a list of customer policies associated with a specific customer.
